verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs confirm a full time-off request lifecycle — balance checking, submission, admin approval/decline, and payroll integration — with either a pre-built approval UI or direct API-driven approvals (gusto-docs-11,19,29,51,55). However, there's no explicit documentation of defining custom PTO accrual policies (e.g., accrual rates, policy types like unlimited/accrual-per-period/frontload) — only 'balance checking' is mentioned, implying accrual balances exist but not that ops users configure the accrual rules themselves. Missing for 10: documentation of accrual policy creation/configuration, evidence of policy-level customization (accrual rate, caps, carryover), and independent/hands-on confirmation that approvals automatically feed payroll runs.
